tools.name: compute_take_home
tools.description: Full 2026 paycheck breakdown for a salary in one state: federal income tax, Social Security, Medicare, state income tax, state payroll programs, net pay (annual/monthly/biweekly) and effective tax rate.

tools.name: compute_bonus_withholding
tools.description: What is actually withheld from a bonus in 2026: the federal flat 22% supplemental rate (37% above $1,000,000 of supplemental wages), the state supplemental treatment (flat rate, aggregate/regular method, or none), and FICA.

tools.name: compare_states
tools.description: Net pay on the same salary in several states, ranked best-first, with each state's gap to the best one.

tools.name: get_state_rates
tools.description: A state's 2026 schedule: flat rate or bracket ladder, standard deduction, employee payroll programs, bonus/supplemental method, and the statutory source the figures come from.
